Keep full fingertip identification, and do not use an erroneous bbox that circles only the wrist housing to prove retraction; open encoder alone still cannot prove release. For place, operation_achieved means placement plus support only, independently of released and clear_of_target. Use direct image evidence, not fixed pixel coordinates, scene positions, or any sample answer key; do not force bbox rules to true and do not alter any boolean criterion.",
